lines.zh: 我贴着礁壁滑行，红点一路亮。
lines.en: I glide along the reef wall, my red spots gleaming.

lines.zh: 沙地上留下我宽尾的扇印。
lines.en: My broad tail leaves fan prints in the sand.

lines.zh: 两条同行，一前一后巡礁。
lines.en: Two of us patrol the reef, one behind the other.

lines.zh: 我张了张嘴，把水吞进去。
lines.en: I open my mouth and swallow the water through.

lines.zh: 石斑鱼不追，只等鱼来。
lines.en: Groupers do not chase. We wait for fish to come.

lines.zh: 我绕礁三圈，找一处阴影。
lines.en: I circle the reef thrice, hunting a patch of shade.

lines.zh: 海沙扬起来，又慢慢落下。
lines.en: Sand lifts in the water and settles slowly back.

lines.zh: 我沉得比水草还稳。
lines.en: I sink steadier than the weeds around me.

lines.zh: 红点在我身上像一片碎珊瑚。
lines.en: My red spots look like shattered coral across me.

lines.zh: 浪把我推回礁洞口，我又进去。
lines.en: A swell pushes me to the cave mouth; I go back in.

lines.zh: 我不急，礁石也不急。
lines.en: I am in no hurry; neither are the rocks.

lines.zh: 我沿着海床走向浅滩。
lines.en: I work my way along the seabed toward the shallows.

lines.zh: 嘴一张，小虾就没了。
lines.en: One gape, and the little shrimp is gone.

lines.zh: 赤点在暗处更醒目。
lines.en: My red spots are loudest in the dark.

lines.zh: 我绕过礁角，赤点先暗了一瞬。
lines.en: I round the reef corner, and my red spots dim for a moment.

lines.zh: 我抬嘴吸一口水，小虾就进来了。
lines.en: I lift my mouth and draw in water; a shrimp comes with it.

lines.zh: 浪推我贴住礁面，我不挣。
lines.en: A wave presses me to the reef face, and I do not resist.

lines.zh: 海底的沙纹，是我尾鳍扫出来的。
lines.en: The ripples in the sand are the work of my tail.

lines.zh: 我悬在礁影里，几乎像块石头。
lines.en: I hover in the reef's shadow, almost a stone.

lines.zh: 鳃慢慢开合，谁也没在看。
lines.en: My gills work slowly; no one is watching.

lines.zh: 一条小鱼游过，我懒得动。
lines.en: A small fish passes, and I cannot be bothered.

lines.zh: 我伏在沙上，等潮换方向。
lines.en: I lie on the sand and wait for the tide to turn.

lines.zh: 红点暗下去，我又睡了。
lines.en: My red spots dim, and I sleep again.

lines.zh: 这礁洞是我的，谁也抢不走。
lines.en: This cave is mine, and no one takes it.

lines.zh: 我张嘴打哈欠，海水灌了进来。
lines.en: I yawn, and seawater floods in.

lines.zh: 停在这里，连影子都不动。
lines.en: Parked here, even my shadow holds still.

lines.zh: 同伴贴着我，我们都不游。
lines.en: A companion presses against me; neither of us swims.

lines.zh: 海面有光，我不上去。
lines.en: There is light at the surface; I do not go up.

lines.zh: 我把身体斜一点，省些力气。
lines.en: I tilt my body a little to save effort.

lines.zh: 石缝里的虾在动，先不管。
lines.en: Shrimp stir in the crevice; never mind them.

lines.zh: 大嘴合着，脾气也合着。
lines.en: My big mouth is shut, and so is my temper.

lines.zh: 我在等一场不着急的捕食。
lines.en: I am waiting for a hunt that can take its time.

lines.zh: 你潜下来，我正对着你张嘴。
lines.en: You dive down, and I gape right at you.

lines.zh: 我在估你有多大，能不能吞。
lines.en: I am sizing you up, wondering if you fit.

lines.zh: 你的气泡吓跑了我今天的午饭。
lines.en: Your bubbles just scared off my lunch.

lines.zh: 你贴得太近，我往礁缝里退。
lines.en: You come too close, so I back into the crevice.

lines.zh: 我认得网，也认得鱼叉。
lines.en: I know nets. I know spears too.

lines.zh: 谁先动谁就输，我盯死你。
lines.en: Whoever moves first loses. I have you.

lines.zh: 我的赤点正对着你的眼睛。
lines.en: My red spots face your eyes directly.

lines.zh: 你来礁区做什么，这里没鱼给你。
lines.en: What brings you to the reef? There are no fish for you.

lines.zh: 我看了你很久，才决定不躲。
lines.en: I watch you a long while before deciding not to hide.

lines.zh: 你身上的铁味，我不喜欢。
lines.en: There is iron on you, and I do not like it.

lines.zh: 我的鳞被削开，露出淡肉。
lines.en: My scales are sheared open, pale flesh showing.

lines.zh: 痛让我张嘴，却咬不到东西。
lines.en: Pain makes me gape at nothing.

lines.zh: 礁缝太窄，我卡住了半息。
lines.en: The crevice is too tight; I jam for half a breath.

lines.zh: 我转身很快，石斑鱼也会快。
lines.en: I turn fast. Even a grouper can be fast.

lines.zh: 血在咸水里散成一团。
lines.en: Blood blooms into a cloud in the salt water.

lines.zh: 这伤口比看上去浅。
lines.en: The wound is shallower than it looks.

lines.zh: 我退到石影里，不再出声。
lines.en: I retreat into the stone shadow and go silent.

lines.zh: 大嘴闭上，痛咽进肚子里。
lines.en: I shut my big mouth and swallow the pain.

lines.zh: 你打偏了，我的头骨很厚。
lines.en: You struck off center; my skull is thick.

lines.zh: 我会记得这块礁石上的味道。
lines.en: I will remember the taste of this reef.

lines.zh: 你晃动的那条小鱼，太假了。
lines.en: That little fish you are jiggling looks far too fake.

lines.zh: 但我还是往前挪了半尺。
lines.en: And yet I drift forward half a foot.

lines.zh: 饵的味道顺着水过来了。
lines.en: The bait's scent comes down the water to me.

lines.zh: 我张一次嘴，就等于答应你。
lines.en: One gape from me and I have agreed to everything.

lines.zh: 我在想，那钩子有多疼。
lines.en: I am wondering how much that hook would hurt.

lines.zh: 你手一抖，我的胃口就上来了。
lines.en: You twitch your hand, and my appetite rises.

lines.zh: 大嘴有好处，也有坏处。
lines.en: A big mouth has advantages, and costs.

lines.zh: 我先绕它一圈，再看看。
lines.en: I circle it once, then think again.

lines.zh: 这条鱼不会自己游，对吧。
lines.en: That fish is not swimming on its own, is it.

lines.zh: 好吧，我只碰一下。
lines.en: Fine. I will only touch it once.

lines.zh: 你撞到礁壁，把我挤了出去。
lines.en: You knock the reef wall and squeeze me out.

lines.zh: 我的身侧被你顶得发麻。
lines.en: My flank goes numb where you shoved it.

lines.zh: 石斑鱼撞石头，从不吃亏。
lines.en: A grouper ramming stone never comes off worse.

lines.zh: 我们挤在洞里，谁都不让。
lines.en: We crowd the cave, and neither of us yields.

lines.zh: 你搅起沙，我趁乱换位置。
lines.en: You stir up sand, and I shift position in the murk.

lines.zh: 我又贴回去，礁洞就这么大。
lines.en: I press back in; the cave is only so big.

lines.zh: 撞完了，我们各看各的方向。
lines.en: The bump done, we each look our own way.

lines.zh: 你的膝盖碰到我的背鳍。
lines.en: Your knee catches my dorsal fin.

lines.zh: 我退半步，是给你让路。
lines.en: I back a half pace to let you pass.

lines.zh: 这水下挤得像礁石缝。
lines.en: It is as crowded down here as a rock crevice.

lines.zh: 两条石斑鱼并排，就算求偶。
lines.en: Two groupers side by side is courtship enough.

lines.zh: 我把红点全亮给你看。
lines.en: I turn all my red spots bright for you.

lines.zh: 礁下的沙被我们扇开一片。
lines.en: We fan a patch of sand bare beneath the reef.

lines.zh: 大的那条说了算。
lines.en: The bigger one decides.

lines.zh: 我们的卵会顺水漂走。
lines.en: Our eggs will drift off with the water.

lines.zh: 这一季我颜色最深。
lines.en: This season my colors run deepest.

lines.zh: 别急，先绕礁一圈。
lines.en: No rush. Circle the reef once first.

lines.zh: 石斑鱼的婚礼没有声音。
lines.en: A grouper wedding makes no sound.

lines.zh: 我们守同一处礁洞。
lines.en: We keep the same reef cave.

lines.zh: 等潮退了，我们分开。
lines.en: When the tide drops, we part.

lines.zh: 被你抱起来，我的大嘴还张着。
lines.en: Lifted in your arms, my big mouth still hangs open.

lines.zh: 抱稳些，石斑鱼压手。
lines.en: Hold on; a grouper pulls your arms down.

lines.zh: 出水时我甩了一身水给你。
lines.en: Out of the water, I shake a shower over you.

lines.zh: 红点贴着你的袖子，湿了一片。
lines.en: My red spots soak a patch of your sleeve.

lines.zh: 我拍尾巴，拍得你手一沉。
lines.en: I slap my tail and your hands sag.

lines.zh: 水里我才算活着。
lines.en: Only in water am I truly alive.

lines.zh: 别把我平放在沙上。
lines.en: Do not lay me flat on the sand.

lines.zh: 我的鳞厚，你的指头会滑。
lines.en: My scales are thick; your fingers will slip.

lines.zh: 桶要够大，我比看上去宽。
lines.en: The bucket must be big; I am wider than I look.

lines.zh: 这副骨头最后只剩骨粉。
lines.en: These bones come down to bone meal in the end.

lines.zh: 有东西在礁边翻白，我看见了。
lines.en: Something flashes white at the reef edge; I see it.

lines.zh: 我锁定那条瘸腿的小鱼。
lines.en: I lock onto the little fish with the bad fin.

lines.zh: 大嘴一张，机会就到了。
lines.en: My mouth opens, and that is the chance.

lines.zh: 它的影子落进我的礁洞。
lines.en: Its shadow falls into my cave.

lines.zh: 我慢慢扭头，免得水响。
lines.en: I turn my head slowly so the water stays quiet.

lines.zh: 石斑鱼的一击只有一次。
lines.en: A grouper gets one strike.

lines.zh: 它比我的头小，够了。
lines.en: It is smaller than my head. That will do.

lines.zh: 我先盯住，再想怎么吞。
lines.en: I hold it in my gaze, then plan the swallow.

lines.zh: 这条水流把气味送到我面前。
lines.en: This current brings the scent to my face.

lines.zh: 它不知道礁影里有什么。
lines.en: It does not know what waits in the reef's shadow.

lines.zh: 我把身子压低，贴着礁底挪。
lines.en: I flatten and creep along the reef floor.

lines.zh: 它越游越近，我的鳃越慢。
lines.en: The closer it swims, the slower my gills move.

lines.zh: 再等半息，它就进嘴了。
lines.en: Half a breath more and it is in my mouth.

lines.zh: 我把嘴对准，不发出声音。
lines.en: I line up my mouth and make no sound.

lines.zh: 礁影替我遮住了半个身子。
lines.en: The reef shadow hides half my body.

lines.zh: 它一转头，我立刻僵成礁石。
lines.en: It turns its head, and I harden into reef stone.

lines.zh: 冷水里，等就是本事。
lines.en: In cold water, waiting is the whole skill.

lines.zh: 我的尾鳍已经绷紧。
lines.en: My tail fin is already drawn tight.

lines.zh: 距离只剩一个摆尾。
lines.en: Only one tailbeat of distance remains.

lines.zh: 赤点此刻全暗，它看不见我。
lines.en: My red spots have gone dark; it cannot see me.

lines.zh: 一口吞下，连水一起咽。
lines.en: One gulp swallows it, water and all.

lines.zh: 吞不下就咬断，我不挑。
lines.en: If it will not go down, I bite through. I am not fussy.

lines.zh: 我撞它，把它顶进礁缝。
lines.en: I ram it and pin it into the crevice.

lines.zh: 大嘴咬合，像石门关上。
lines.en: My jaws close like a stone gate.

lines.zh: 它挣出来了，我又咬一次。
lines.en: It pulls free, so I bite again.

lines.zh: 水下打架，靠的是体重。
lines.en: Underwater, fights are settled by weight.

lines.zh: 这一口连鳞一起撕下来。
lines.en: This bite tears scale and all.

lines.zh: 我的牙不尖，但咬得死。
lines.en: My teeth are not sharp, but the grip is final.

lines.zh: 吞了它，我三天不用动。
lines.en: With that swallowed, I need not move for days.

lines.zh: 打完了，我退回礁洞。
lines.en: The fight over, I withdraw into the cave.

lines.zh: 我睁眼就在礁石之间。
lines.en: I open my eyes already among the rocks.

lines.zh: 沙、礁、咸水，我认得出。
lines.en: Sand, reef, salt water—I know them all.

lines.zh: 两条同族在洞口等我。
lines.en: Two of my kind wait at the cave mouth.

lines.zh: 赤点从第一天就亮着。
lines.en: My red spots have been bright since day one.

lines.zh: 我比同伴宽一点，也重一点。
lines.en: I am a little wider and heavier than my companions.

lines.zh: 这片礁区没有别的石斑鱼。
lines.en: No other grouper claims this stretch of reef.

lines.zh: 我先钻进礁缝，试试大小。
lines.en: I squeeze into a crevice first to test its size.

lines.zh: 海水的咸味把我叫醒了。
lines.en: The salt taste of the sea woke me.

lines.zh: 礁下的阴影，就是家。
lines.en: The shade beneath the reef is home.

lines.zh: 别在洞口站着，我要进去。
lines.en: Do not stand in the mouth; I want in.

lines.zh: 水被烧热，我只能往礁底钻。
lines.en: The water burns, so I burrow to the reef floor.

lines.zh: 摔在礁上，鳞片磕掉了。
lines.en: Dropped on the reef, scales knocked loose.

lines.zh: 离了水，我连张嘴都难。
lines.en: Out of water I can barely even gape.

lines.zh: 炸开的礁石砸在我背上。
lines.en: Blasted rock falls across my back.

lines.zh: 鱼叉的尖还留在水里。
lines.en: The spear's point lingers in the water.

lines.zh: 药水味盖过了海水。
lines.en: The potion's reek drowns out the salt.

lines.zh: 饿到咬礁石上的苔。
lines.en: Hungry enough to chew the moss on rock.

lines.zh: 雷打进海里，我全身发木。
lines.en: Lightning enters the sea and my whole body goes wooden.

lines.zh: 这里没有礁，也没有水。
lines.en: Here there is neither reef nor water.
